name: Crypto Watchlist
description: A compact Bitcoin, Ethereum, and Solana market snapshot with 24-hour performance and USD market stats.
template: <Stack gap="sm"><Group justify="space-between" wrap="nowrap" gap="xs"><Stack gap={0} style={{ minWidth: 0 }}><Text fw={700} truncate>Crypto watchlist</Text><Text size="xs" c="dimmed">24-hour market snapshot</Text></Stack><RefreshButton requestId="quotes" /></Group>{status.quotes?.loading ? <Stack gap="sm"><Skeleton height={52} /><Skeleton height={52} /><Skeleton height={52} /></Stack> : status.quotes?.ok === false ? <Alert color="red" title="Market data unavailable">{status.quotes.statusText || status.quotes.error || "Request failed"}</Alert> : (data.quotes?.data ?? []).length === 0 ? <Text size="sm" c="dimmed">No market data returned</Text> : <Stack gap="sm">{(data.quotes?.data ?? []).map(asset => <Stack key={asset.id} gap={4}><Group justify="space-between" wrap="nowrap" gap="xs"><Stack gap={0} style={{ minWidth: 0 }}><Text size="sm" fw={600} truncate>{asset.name ?? "Unknown asset"}</Text><Text size="xs" c="dimmed">{asset.symbol ?? "—"}</Text></Stack><Stack gap={0} align="flex-end"><Text fw={700} style={{ whiteSpace: "nowrap" }}>{asset.quote?.[0]?.price?.toLocaleString("en-US", { style: "currency", currency: "USD", minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 }) ?? "—"}</Text><Badge color={asset.quote?.[0]?.percent_change_24h > 0 ? "green" : asset.quote?.[0]?.percent_change_24h < 0 ? "red" : "gray"} variant="light">{asset.quote?.[0]?.percent_change_24h?.toLocaleString("en-US", { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2, signDisplay: "always" }) ?? "—"}%</Badge></Stack></Group><Group justify="space-between" wrap="nowrap" gap="xs"><Group gap={4} wrap="nowrap"><Text size="xs" c="dimmed">Market cap</Text><Text size="xs" fw={600}>{asset.quote?.[0]?.market_cap?.toLocaleString("en-US", { style: "currency", currency: "USD", notation: "compact", maximumFractionDigits: 1 }) ?? "—"}</Text></Group><Group gap={4} wrap="nowrap"><Text size="xs" c="dimmed">24h volume</Text><Text size="xs" fw={600}>{asset.quote?.[0]?.volume_24h?.toLocaleString("en-US", { style: "currency", currency: "USD", notation: "compact", maximumFractionDigits: 1 }) ?? "—"}</Text></Group></Group></Stack>)}</Stack>}{data.quotes?.data?.[0]?.last_updated ? <Text size="xs" c="dimmed">Updated {Date.toLocaleString(data.quotes.data[0].last_updated, "en-US", "UTC")} UTC</Text> : null}</Stack>
